title: AutoReplant
description: A Minecraft plugin that enables auto-harvesting and auto-replanting for crops with a single click.
body:
### AutoReplant
**Features:**
*   **Auto-harvest & Auto-replant:** Supports wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, nether wart, and cocoa beans.
*   **Auto-collect:** Automatically harvests pumpkins and melons directly into your inventory.
*   **Toggle Command:** Use `/autoreplant` (or `/ar`, `/autoplant`) to enable or disable the feature for yourself.
*   **Performance:** Lightweight, optimized, and supports custom crop growth stages.

Enjoy your farming!
